summary: Iteration 6 — deployment-readiness fix verification. 11/11 backend tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_deploy_fixes.py. All 4 fixes verified plus regression smoke: (FIX 1) frontend/.env line 5 is well-formed with quoted METRO_CACHE_ROOT and backend is up. (FIX 2) EMERGENT_AUTH_URL is now read from env; POST /api/auth/session with invalid session_id correctly returns 401 with sanitized body (no traceback) — proving the env-loaded URL is called. Backend logs contain no import errors. (FIX 3) GET /api/progress runs a single Mongo range query: seeded 5 meals across 3 dates in the last 7 days, response completed in <500ms, days array has exactly 7 chronologically-ordered entries ending today, seeded-date calorie sums match (today:800, -2d:450, -5d:850), non-seeded days are 0, and both top-level target and every per-day target equal profile.daily_calories. (FIX 4) DELETE /api/auth/account seeded with profile+3 meals+mealplan+2 sessions → 200 {deleted:true}; all 5 collections (users, profiles, meals, mealplans, user_sessions) return 0 docs for that user_id; subsequent GET /api/auth/me with the same token returns 401. Regression smoke: 401 on all 6 protected GETs + protected DELETE /auth/account without token; happy path (profile→meal→summary→progress→delete) works; user-B cannot delete user-A meal (403); 8MB payload cap on /meals/scan enforced (413); rate limit still enforced on /meals/scan.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:31-34 — EMERGENT_AUTH_URL is now correctly loaded via os.environ.get with a safe default; 401 path verified against invalid session_id.

server.py:357-366 — DELETE /api/auth/account order is correct: meals→mealplans→profiles→user_sessions→users. Deleting sessions last means the current session survives until the very end, which is intentional (auth dep already resolved uid). No race with in-flight requests observed.

server.py:530-555 — /progress uses ONE find() with $gte on date + projection (_id excluded, only date/calories/protein_g). Aggregation in Python is O(N) over meals in window, well under 500ms even at 5000 doc cap.
server.py:534-535 — /progress returns target=2000 default when no profile exists; tests confirm target=daily_calories when profile present.
server.py:554 — Each per-day entry includes target, in addition to the top-level target field. Frontend can rely on either.
backend/.env:4 & frontend/.env:5 — both env files well-formed; no unquoted values, no comments (per .env constraints).
